1º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 1

Hello! Greetings and names

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Say hello and goodbye
  • Say good morning, good afternoon and good night
  • Ask and say names: What's your name? My name is…
  • Ask and answer How are you?
  • Say please, thank you and sorry

Para pensar

A new girl comes to your class. She is from London. What do you say?

Explicación

1. Hello! Hi!

When we meet someone, we say Hello!

We can also say Hi! It is short and friendly.

Say hello to your teacher. Say hi to your friends. Wave your hand and smile!

2. Good morning!

In the morning we say Good morning!

The sun is up. We get up and go to school.

When you arrive at school, say: Good morning, teacher! Your teacher says: Good morning, children!

3. Good afternoon and good night

After lunch we say Good afternoon!

At bedtime we say Good night! The moon and the stars are in the sky.

Say good night to your family. Then close your eyes and sleep.

4. What's your name?

To know a name, we ask: What's your name?

We answer: My name is… and say our name.

For example: My name is Lucía. We can also say I'm Lucía. Ask three friends their names!

5. Nice to meet you!

When we meet a new friend, we say Nice to meet you!

The friend answers: Nice to meet you, too!

We can shake hands or give a high five. It is a happy way to start a friendship.

6. How are you?

To ask about feelings, we say How are you?

We can answer: I'm fine, thank you! or I'm happy!

If we are not well, we say I'm sad or I'm tired. It's OK to say how you feel.

7. How old are you?

To ask about age, we say How old are you?

We answer with a number: I'm six. or I'm seven.

Show the number with your fingers. Six is five fingers and one more!

8. Please and thank you

Kind words are magic words.

When we ask for something, we say please. When someone gives us something, we say thank you.

The answer to thank you is You're welcome!

9. Sorry!

If we hurt someone by mistake, we say Sorry!

The other person can say That's OK!

Saying sorry makes friends happy again. It is a very important word in every language.

10. Goodbye! See you!

When we leave, we say Goodbye! or Bye-bye!

If we will see the person soon, we say See you tomorrow! or See you later!

Wave your hand. Bye-bye!

11. Game: the name ball

Stand in a circle. Throw a soft ball to a friend.

Say: Hello! What's your name? Your friend catches it and says: My name is…

Then your friend throws the ball. Play until everybody says their name!

12. Review: I can say hello!

Now you can say hello and goodbye.

You can say good morning and good night. You can ask What's your name? and How are you?

You know the magic words: please, thank you and sorry. Well done!

Greetings all day

Ejercicios

  1. Say hello to your teacher.

  2. Say goodbye to a friend.

  3. Draw a sun. Write: Good morning!

  4. Draw a moon. Write: Good night!

  5. Say your name in English.

  6. What do you say when someone gives you a present?

  7. Wave your hand and say bye-bye.

  8. Match: Hello – Hola, Goodbye – Adiós.

  9. Complete: What's your ____?

  10. Complete: My ____ is Ana.

  11. Answer: How are you?

  12. Answer: How old are you?

  13. It is 4 o'clock in the afternoon. What do you say?

  14. Order the words: name / your / What's / ?

  15. You push a friend by mistake. What do you say?

  16. Your friend says «Thank you!». What do you answer?

  17. Draw your face and write how you feel: I'm happy / I'm sad / I'm tired.

  18. Make a short dialogue with a friend: hello, name, how are you, goodbye.

  19. Introduce a toy: «This is my teddy. His name is…».

  20. Write three magic words in English.

  21. Ask three people at home «How are you?» and write their answers.

  22. Sing a hello song and teach it to your family.

Practica

  1. How do we say «hola»?

    1. A) Goodbye
    2. B) Hello
    3. C) Thank you

  2. In the morning we say…

    1. A) Good morning
    2. B) Good night
    3. C) Bye-bye

  3. At bedtime we say…

    1. A) Good afternoon
    2. B) Hello
    3. C) Good night

  4. What's your name? →

    1. A) I'm fine
    2. B) I'm six
    3. C) My name is Ana

  5. How are you? →

    1. A) My name is Leo
    2. B) I'm fine, thank you
    3. C) Goodbye

  6. How old are you? →

    1. A) I'm seven
    2. B) I'm happy
    3. C) Hello

  7. When we leave we say…

    1. A) Goodbye
    2. B) Hello
    3. C) Please

  8. To ask for something we say…

    1. A) sorry
    2. B) night
    3. C) please

  9. Someone gives you a gift. You say…

    1. A) Sorry
    2. B) Thank you
    3. C) Good night

  10. After lunch we say…

    1. A) Good morning
    2. B) Good afternoon
    3. C) Good night

  11. «Nice to meet you» is for…

    1. A) bedtime
    2. B) a mistake
    3. C) a new friend

  12. Oops! I push you. I say…

    1. A) Sorry
    2. B) Thank you
    3. C) Hello

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: How we say hello and goodbye; How we ask and say a name; Which greeting we use in the morning and at night.

Resumen

Glosario

Hello
A word to greet someone (hola).
Goodbye
A word to say when you leave (adiós).
Good morning
A greeting for the morning (buenos días).
Good afternoon
A greeting for after lunch (buenas tardes).
Good night
Words for bedtime (buenas noches).
Name
What people call you (nombre).
Please
A kind word to ask for something (por favor).
Thank you
A kind word when you get something (gracias).
Sorry
A word when you make a mistake (perdón).
Friend
A person you like and play with (amigo, amiga).

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

HolaHello! / Hi!
AdiósGoodbye! / Bye-bye!
Buenos díasGood morning!
Buenas nochesGood night!
¿Cómo te llamas?What's your name?
Me llamo AnaMy name is Ana.
¿Cómo estás?How are you?
GraciasThank you!
Por favorPlease
PerdónSorry!

Soluciones

  1. B) Hello! or Hi!
  2. A) Good morning!
  3. C) Good night!
  4. C) We say our name.
  5. B) We say how we feel.
  6. A) We say our age.
  7. A) Goodbye! Bye-bye!
  8. C) Please is a magic word.
  9. B) Thank you!
  10. B) Afternoon is after lunch.
  11. C) When we meet someone new.
  12. A) Sorry!

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. Hello! / Good morning, teacher!
  2. Goodbye! / Bye-bye!
  3. A sun and the words «Good morning!».
  4. A moon and the words «Good night!».
  5. My name is… (your name).
  6. Thank you!
  7. Bye-bye!
  8. Hello = hola; Goodbye = adiós.
  9. name.
  10. name.
  11. I'm fine, thank you! / I'm happy!
  12. I'm six. / I'm seven.
  13. Good afternoon!
  14. What's your name?
  15. Sorry!
  16. You're welcome!
  17. A face and one sentence, for example «I'm happy».
  18. Hello! What's your name? My name is… How are you? I'm fine, thank you. Goodbye!
  19. This is my teddy. His name is Max.
  20. Please, thank you, sorry.
  21. Free answer, for example: Mum: I'm fine. Dad: I'm tired.
  22. Free answer: sing and share the song.
